cause_1_vehicle_class_exclusion.finding: exactly 4 of 150 counted edges forbid passenger vehicles, and they are exactly the 4 edges no pool route traverses - a 1:1 match with no false positives or negatives
cause_1_vehicle_class_exclusion.mechanism: the route pool was generated with randomTrips --vehicle-class passenger, so a passenger trip can never traverse a bus/bicycle-only lane. Their counts are unmet by construction, at any pool size.
cause_1_vehicle_class_exclusion.upstream_reachability_is_normal: these four have 259-522 upstream edges within 8 hops against a typical-edge median of 208, so topology is not their problem - permission is
cause_1_vehicle_class_exclusion.why_it_is_a_modelling_mismatch_not_a_poo: DfT raw counts count motor vehicles including buses; the pool is passenger-only. A passenger-only demand can never reproduce a count taken on a bus lane, so these targets are unattainable rather than under-supplied.

cause_2_boundary_truncated_motorway.already_recorded_as_a_limitation: the 25-July subnetwork record states that routes in a clipped network necessarily start and end at the boundary; this quantifies what that costs
cause_2_boundary_truncated_motorway.finding: the two edges carrying 61.4% of the entire shortfall are M56 motorway segments at the southern clip boundary, traversed by exactly 2 pool routes each against a median of 395

geographic_confirmation.note: the two edges carrying most of the shortfall are the two southernmost counted edges in the study area, sitting within 40 m of the extreme of the counted-edge extent

cause_2_boundary_truncated_motorway.mechanism: clipping the parent at the local-authority boundary truncates through-traffic on the motorway. One of the pair is near-isolated (a single upstream edge within 8 hops against a typical 208); both sit off the natural path structure between interior origins and destinations, so a shortest-path pool almost never uses them.

consequence_for_the_predeclared_variants.V2_trip_length_envelope: changes neither cause, and shortening routes can only reduce the chance of reaching a boundary motorway
consequence_for_the_predeclared_variants.V3_double_the_pool: cannot help: twice zero routes is zero, and a permission ban is not a sampling problem
consequence_for_the_predeclared_variants.conclusion: the shortfall is dominated by two structural causes that no predeclared variant addresses
